name: Ojou-sama wa Gokigen Naname
original_name: お嬢様はご機嫌ナナメ
source:
Hajime had been Nanami’s loyal servant ever since her family took him and his younger sister Hana in after their parents passed away. Every day, he fends off the succession of men from noble families who come to propose to her. One day, Nanami came to their run-down apartment and asked him to teach her the life of the common people. At the same time, a fellow student at Tenshouin Academy, Otoha, asked for his advice in becoming an idol, and Nanami’s cool friend Touka also started acting weird. Then the daughter of the Naname group’s rival corporation, Shiaya, proposed to him all of a sudden. What will happen to him?

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
自從父母去世後，七海的家人收留了他和他的妹妹花，始就一直是七海忠實的僕人。每天，他都要抵禦一連串前來向她求婚的貴族男子。有一天，七海來到他們破舊的公寓，請求他教她平民的生活。與此同時，天照院學園的同學乙葉向他尋求成為偶像的建議，而七海那位個性酷酷的朋友燈香也開始表現得很奇怪。這時，七海集團競爭對手公司的女兒Shiaya突然向他求婚了。他該如何是好？

［來自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/05/25/may-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri！[/url]］
